description.text: Program description: This major develops the basic physical and chemical laws of the chemical production process and equipment, and gets the basic training of scientific research and application research. It is competent for the research, development, design, system analysis and optimization of the chemical production process and new products. It can be used in chemical and chemical related fields. Scientific research, teaching, engineering management and technological innovation work to meet the needs of China's economic construction of high-quality professionals.Major courses: Inorganic Chemistry and experiment, organic chemistry and experiment, physical chemistry and experiment, analytical chemistry and experiment, chemical engineering principles and experiments, chemical thermodynamics, chemical reaction engineering, chemical technology, chemical drawing, instrument analysis and experiment, and the application of computer in chemistry.The direction of professional employment: 1. Engaged in the research, development, design, system analysis and optimization of the chemical production process and new products 2. Engaged in scientific research, teaching, engineering management and technological innovation in the field of chemistry and chemical related fields 3. Engaged in the general control work of chemical industry and other industries 4. organization and management in related industries and government departments

duration.text: The Chemical and Environment Engineering at Nanchang Hangkong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese nationals in good health2.Graduated from an institution equal to Chinese senior high school (for undergraduate applicants)
